jobs.title: Lead Mobile Software Engineer
jobs.summary: Founding mobile engineer. Owned the Android app's architecture, releases, and code quality.
highlights: Built and launched the native Android app from scratch with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Jetpack ViewModel, and Jetpack Navigation, then kept it current through refactors as Compose matured

Implemented HIPAA requirements in the app: session timeouts, PHI-safe logging, and MFA for member logins through Descope. No PHI is persisted on the device, and the only stored data is encrypted and limited to member login
Integrated Paytient and Very Good Security to manage and protect Gravie Pay card information
Added member ID cards to Google Wallet, following Google's processes for handling PHI in the Wallet ecosystem
Designed and implemented a Kotlin microservice connecting core Gravie systems to Salesforce, streamlining how members get in contact with Gravie Care
Moved hardcoded UI logic into Clojure/Groovy backends alongside backend engineers, so static content changes no longer required a new app release
Set up CI/CD pipelines to the Play Store with automated unit and functional testing, Detekt and ktlint checks, and Slack alerts for nightly test results
Ran sprint planning and Scrum ceremonies, mentored junior engineers, and set code review and quality guidelines

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.summary: Clinical communication and collaboration software for Android with strict performance and privacy requirements.
highlights: Tech/Team Lead for in-person, remote, and offshore developers
Architected and built client-side authentication on the Android Keystore, plus authenticated RESTful API access
Integrated AWS IoT to deliver real-time text messages and clinical alerts to patient care teams
Architected and rolled out MVVM with Jetpack components and a common DataBinding RecyclerView Adapter
Implemented feature flagging to support a Continuous Delivery model
Implemented a Room (SQLite) cache for downloaded data
Automated pull request verification and release builds with GitHub Actions, and managed Play Store submission and release
